A little about the baker

From my kitchen, with love.

I’ve been baking since I was around 10 years old, and over the years it’s grown into so much more than a hobby. Baking has always been one of my favorite ways to be creative, make something special, and bring a little happiness to someone’s day.

One of my favorite things is sharing the baked goods I make with the people around me. That love for baking—and for sharing every delicious batch—is what inspired me to turn my longtime hobby into The Sugared Batch.

Here, every small batch is made with care and plenty of love. Thank you for being here, supporting my little bakery, and letting me share something I’ve loved doing since I was a kid.
